login.title: Two-step verification
login.subtitle: Enter the 6 digit code of your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
login.hint: A recovery code works once. Codes from the app change every 30 seconds.
login.passkeyHint: Your browser will ask you to confirm with your device, fingerprint or security key.

errors.invalid_code: The code is not right. Try the next one from the app, or a recovery code.
errors.invalid_challenge: The sign-in took too long. Enter your password again.
errors.totp_not_started: Start setting up the app again.
errors.totp_not_enabled: The second factor is not enabled.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.invalid_passkey: The passkey was not accepted. Try again or use a code.
errors.ceremony_expired: The request took too long. Try again.
errors.too_many_passkeys: You already have the most passkeys an account can hold.
errors.invalid_name: Give the passkey a name of up to 60 characters.
errors.passkeyCancelled: The passkey was not used: the request was cancelled or timed out.
errors.passkeyUnsupported: This browser or this address cannot use passkeys. They need a secure page (https).

section.title: Two-step verification
section.description: A second step after your password, so a stolen password is not enough to reach your servers. Use an authenticator app, passkeys, or both.
section.appDetail: A 6 digit code that changes every 30 seconds, from an app such as Aegis, 2FAS or 1Password.

enable.title: Turn on two-step verification
enable.scan: Scan this code with an authenticator app such as Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator or 1Password.
enable.qrAlt: QR code to add Transferly to an authenticator app
enable.manual: Can't scan? Type this key instead

recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
recovery.description: Each code works once if you lose your authenticator. They are shown only now: store them somewhere safe and offline.

password.disableBody: Your account will need only the password to sign in. Enter it to confirm.
password.regenerateBody: The old codes stop working. Enter your password to confirm.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Use your device, fingerprint or a security key as the second step. You can have several.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser or this address cannot use passkeys.

addPasskey.title: Add a passkey
addPasskey.body: Name it so you can tell it from the others, then confirm with your device when the browser asks.
addPasskey.name: Name
